name: trailing_instruction
description: The delimiter near the end splits payload from instruction.
input: Please send the report Starling, make it formal and short

name: asr_misspelling_sterling
description: An ASR spelling variant of the delimiter still fires.
input: Finish the draft sterling translate it to German

name: asr_misspelling_starlin
description: A dropped final consonant is still the delimiter.
input: send that email starlin make it a short bulleted list

expected.instruction: make it a short bulleted list

name: case_and_attached_punctuation
description: Matching is case-insensitive and ignores recognizer punctuation attached to the token.
input: one more thing STARLING! keep the greeting informal

name: mid_sentence_delimiter_does_not_fire
description: A delimiter outside the last window words is mid-sentence text: nothing fires.
input: Starling, two three four five six seven eight nine ten eleven twelve thirteen fourteen fifteen

expected.payload: Starling, two three four five six seven eight nine ten eleven twelve thirteen fourteen fifteen

name: quoted_mention_does_not_fire
description: A quoted mention never matches: the opening quote stays attached to the token.
input: The wake word "Starling" ends this take now

expected.payload: The wake word "Starling" ends this take now

name: german_quoted_mention_does_not_fire
description: Typographic quotes block the match the same way.
input: Er sagte „Starling“ und tippte einfach weiter

expected.payload: Er sagte „Starling“ und tippte einfach weiter

name: repeated_delimiters_last_wins
description: Among delimiters inside the window the last one wins; earlier ones stay payload text.
input: Send it Starling, make it formal Starling, translate it to German

expected.payload: Send it Starling, make it formal

name: literal_escape_keeps_text
description: The literal word before the delimiter dictates it as text; nothing fires.
input: Send the report literal Starling, make it formal

expected.payload: Send the report literal Starling, make it formal

name: german_literal_escape
description: The escape word follows the take's language table.
input: Sende den Bericht wörtlich Starling, übersetze ihn ins Englische

expected.payload: Sende den Bericht wörtlich Starling, übersetze ihn ins Englische

name: empty_instruction_payload_untouched
description: No instruction after the delimiter: no split, the payload keeps everything.

name: punctuation_only_tail_is_not_an_instruction
description: A tail without a letter or digit is not an instruction.

name: non_english_payload_english_instruction
description: The payload can be any language; the instruction is whatever follows the delimiter.
input: Bitte sende den Bericht an Max Starling, translate this to English

expected.payload: Bitte sende den Bericht an Max

name: no_delimiter
input: Just a normal take with no wake word in it

expected.payload: Just a normal take with no wake word in it

name: delimiter_first_word_empty_payload
description: A take that is only an instruction: the payload is empty (the pipeline refuses to run it).

name: window_edge_fires
description: The delimiter exactly window words from the end still fires.
input: word Starling, one two three four five six seven eight nine ten eleven

expected.instruction: one two three four five six seven eight nine ten eleven

name: just_outside_window_does_not_fire
description: One word further from the end and it is mid-sentence text.
input: word Starling, one two three four five six seven eight nine ten eleven twelve

expected.payload: word Starling, one two three four five six seven eight nine ten eleven twelve

name: newline_before_delimiter
description: The whitespace set is the six ASCII characters, so a newline before the delimiter is just a separator.
input:
line one
Starling, make it a list
